network_enforcement: Fresh target sources and output files are placed in a temporary directory. Every Lean subprocess runs at trust level zero inside bubblewrap --unshare-net with the root filesystem and pinned canonical dependency artifacts read-only; only the temporary directory is writable. This is a warm-cache node-scoped worker replay, not clean-checkout empty-cache release reproduction.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line PASS/BLOCKED release reconciliation summary

scope_boundary: Fail-closed worker reconciliation of the current accepted authority and provisional proof/validation evidence, with a trust-zero, network-isolated, fresh-output replay over existing pinned warm artifacts. It cannot master-accept the validation dependency, correct the frozen graph, accept H0/R0 or complete trust/provenance, perform clean empty-cache offline reproduction, supply distinct signed runners or an independent minimal verifier, assemble a deterministic release bundle, or establish AUDIT-Z/THEOREM-Z.
